name: ABS
meaning: absolute value, INT_MIN maps to itself

name: ORS4
ref: int t = x | (x >> 1); t |= t >> 2; return t | (t >> 4);

name: ORS8
ref: int t = x | (x >> 1); t |= t >> 2; t |= t >> 4; return t | (t >> 8);

name: SMEAR
meaning: spread 16 — all bits below the top set bit

name: NEXTP2
meaning: smallest power of two >= x, zero for x <= 0
ref: unsigned u=(unsigned)x; if(x<=0) return 0; u--; u|=u>>1; u|=u>>2;u|=u>>4; u|=u>>8; u|=u>>16; u++; return (int)u;

name: XF4
ref: int t = x ^ (x >> 16); t ^= t >> 8; return t ^ (t >> 4);

name: PARITY
meaning: 1 if an odd number of bits set

name: CTZ_M
meaning: x with only trailing zeros marked: (~x) & (x-1)

name: ILOG2P
meaning: the top set bit isolated, zero for x <= 0
ref: unsigned u=(unsigned)x; if(x<=0) return 0; u|=u>>1; u|=u>>2;u|=u>>4; u|=u>>8; u|=u>>16; return (int)(u - (u >> 1));

name: PC8
meaning: popcount partial: byte sums folded into half sums

name: POPCNT
meaning: how many bits of x are set

name: BSWAP
meaning: reverse the four bytes of x
